verdict: Red 8/10 REJECT, blue 8/10 SUSTAINED with corrections - concordant, and the most complete refutation of a thesis's central valuation claim in this batch. The triage classified GOTU DAMAGE-ABSENT on the demand axis and scored it 8/10 court-worthy on one number: at RMB3,264.8M of liquid assets (cash 654.2, restricted 36.9, ST investments 2,072.3, LT investments 501.4), roughly US$455M against a US$436M market cap, the stock traded at about 0.96x its own liquid assets while prepaid customer cash grew 24.1% year over year and three consecutive quarters beat the top of guidance with widening magnitude. The triage flagged its own unclosed caveat honestly - total debt unverified, derived total liabilities of RMB4,280M - and said the thesis rests on deferred revenue being SERVICED at a 69.5% gross margin rather than repaid. Red closed exactly that caveat from the company's own balance sheet and the floor disappears. Non-deferred liabilities are RMB2,487.6M: accrued and other of 1,371.1, short-term borrowings of 300.0, long-term borrowings of 117.5, due-to-related-parties of 181.8, operating leases of 443.2 and deferred tax of 74.0. Liquid assets less those is RMB777.2M, roughly US$108M or 25% of market cap, and after the thesis's own RMB547M delivery charge about US$32M, or 7%. Blue verified every line to the digit and then made the necessary correction to red's own arithmetic: red's 7% figure DOUBLE-COUNTS, netting the full accrued line (which contains the teacher-payroll delivery machinery) and separately charging a modeled cost-to-serve for the same obligation. Corrected, financial assets less borrowings less related-party gives RMB2,665M, which is about RMB873M (roughly 30% of cap) if deferred revenue is repaid at par and about RMB2,118M (roughly 72%) if serviced at the bull's 30.5% cost. Neither is a floor ABOVE the price; both beat red's 7%. The verdict survives the correction, the magnitude does not. Red also found what the triage missed on the corroborating metric, and it is the sharper point: the triage leaned on deferred revenue growing 24.1%, faster than revenue's 13.2%, as proof that demand is intact. But gross billings - the LEADING flow - grew 12.1%, which is SLOWER than recognized revenue's 13.2%. The leading indicator has already crossed under the lagging one; the +24.1% stock is last year's build. Blue sustained this while properly narrowing its scope: N=1 quarter with a 1.1pp gap, and the +24.1% backlog still feeds the coming print directly, so the crossover threatens H2 rather than the 8/26 beat mechanics. The unit economics are unambiguous on both benches: selling expenses of RMB844,111 thousand are exactly 50.0% of revenue, operating income fell to RMB6.9M from RMB34.8M, and net income fell 72.2%. Growth is being bought and the cash demand per marketing dollar is falling. Blue's own decisive new finding is the one both the triage and red walked past, and it was sitting in the pack's own primary excerpt: Q1-26 net operating cash OUTFLOW of RMB828.4M, up 73.6% from RMB477.2M. The freshest cash datum directly contradicts the triage's FY25 '+23.1% operating cash flow' comfort leg, and the prosecution never cited it. Blue also sharpened the frame structurally: current deferred revenue of RMB1,628.7M is about 60% of cash plus short-term investments of RMB2,726.5M, so the 'liquid assets' are substantially CUSTOMER FLOAT rather than shareholder cash. On structure and control, both benches land in the same place. Both borrowing lines are labelled verbatim as obligations of the consolidated VIEs without recourse to the Group - blue confirmed the language and noted correctly that non-recourse cuts both ways, since creditors cannot reach the parent but the assets inside the VIEs service the debt. Where the RMB2.07B of short-term investments actually sits, onshore VIE versus offshore Cayman/HK, is undisclosed, and PRC tuition-prepayment custody rules encumber prepaid-fee cash. The 20-F consolidating schedule that would resolve situs was 403-blocked on every stage. Against a founder holding 52.4% economics and 90.9% of the vote, with a market cap below the gross cash he controls, red's reflexive endgame - a take-under at his price - is a real and unbounded tail, and the $97.9M of buybacks through 6/1/26 validates only about 21% of the claimed stack as offshore and spendable. This is the doctrine call: blue ruled explicitly that GOTU is NOT salvageable as RP_FAIR because fairness is unverifiable and the control-plus-situs tail is unbounded, which fails the fairly-paid bar. That is an AVOID, not a WATCH - the reopen gates are real but they are all requests for disclosure that a 90.9%-voting founder has no obligation to provide.
reopen_gates: 20-F consolidating schedule showing at least US$150M of the short-term-investment stack held at the Cayman or HK parents, unencumbered. This is THE gate - cash situs is the difference between a 30-72% asset backing and a number that belongs to onshore VIE creditors and prepaid-tuition custody rules. 403-blocked on all three stages; route through the r.jina.ai EDGAR proxy.

Composition of the RMB1,371.1M accrued-and-other line. Blue showed red's 7% floor double-counts by netting this line in full AND charging a separate delivery cost; if the line is mostly refund reserves already captured in the deferred math, the corrected 30-72% band narrows upward. Neither bench could decompose it.

Q2 gross billings growth ABOVE revenue growth - reversing the 12.1% versus 13.2% crossover. One quarter at N=1 with a 1.1pp gap is thin; two quarters of crossover confirms the S&M treadmill is losing.

Fresh buyback dollars deployed AFTER 2026-06-01 at current prices. The $97.9M through 6/1/26 is cumulative and multi-year, validating only about 21% of the claimed cash stack as genuinely offshore and spendable.
Operating cash flow returning to positive. The Q1-26 outflow of RMB828.4M (up 73.6% YoY) is the freshest and most damaging cash datum in the record and neither the triage nor red cited it.

Note: none of these gates are within minority holders' power to compel. At 90.9% voting control the disclosure that would clear this name is entirely discretionary, which is itself the reason for AVOID rather than WATCH.
